Maya Patel: Postmortem follow-up: we're still seeing recurring vendor-side auth throttles that trigger token-refresh storms and a separate pattern where registry writes stall under IO pressure. Need a concise remediation plan with owners and deadlines.
Jordan Lee: Proposed lanes: short (config + runbook), medium (alerts + synthetic), long (architecture: regional passive replica + active failover).
Priya Nair: I'll own vendor lane. Action: open formal vendor RCA and request throttling logs + edge config. ETA: Thu COB.
Linh Tran: I'll take immediate mitigations: implement client-side refresh damping (add per-client jitter and exponential backoff, cap concurrent refreshes to 5) and early-return 429 if registry write queue > 400. ETA: 48h.
Maya Patel: Good. Telemetry: need auth.refresh.success_rate per-region, registry.write.p95/p99, and a trend that correlates provider throttles with our retry bursts. Also want an automated synthetic that posts a tiny model tag every 15m and validates token handshake.
Jordan Lee: I'll add metrics and alerts: auth.refresh.success_rate < 98% for 10m -> page infra; registry.write.p95 > 800ms for 5m -> page. I'll also create the synthetic heartbeat and wire it to alerts. ETA: 72h.
Priya Nair: Vendor request draft: please provide log slices for token refresh spikes on dates A/B/C, confirm whether they apply per-IP or per-customer rate limits, and consider edge-side smoothing for refreshes. I'll attach our evidence and ask for a joint debug session.
Maya Patel: Runbook (short):
```
- If auth.refresh.success_rate < 98% for 10m -> page infra oncall
- Infra oncall: enable local token-extend (add +30s keepalive) and enable client refresh cap
- If registry.write.queue_len > 400 -> enable write-throttle mode (route low-priority requests to degraded path)
- Escalate to Priya for vendor engagement if vendor throttle indicators present
```
Linh Tran: I'll submit PR for client-side damping and write-throttle: https://git.internal/redwood/registry/pull/1303 (WIP). It will include metrics: client.refresh.block_count and registry.write.throttle_count.
Jordan Lee: ops-bot created ticket: INC-2932 for synthetic + alerts. Link: https://issues.redwood/INC-2932
Maya Patel: Ownership summary:
- Client damping + write-throttle: Linh (owner)
- Metrics + synthetic + alerts: Jordan (owner)
- Vendor engagement & RCA: Priya (owner)
- Incident tracking & checklist: Ops (ops-bot)
Maya Patel: Timelines: short fixes 48h, metrics + synthetic 72h, vendor outreach Thu, vendor sync Fri 09:00 PT. If anyone is blocked, notify here.
Priya Nair: Vendor ticket opened: VND-7543. Scheduled joint debug Fri 09:00 PT.
Linh Tran: PR opened and ready for review: https://git.internal/redwood/registry/pull/1303. Tests failing on flaky env, debugging now.
Jordan Lee: Added dashboard and alerts. Synthetic is deployed to smoke harness, creating INC-2932 alerts to signal failures.
Maya Patel: We'll re-evaluate recurrence after one week of synthetic runs. If throttles persist, we'll move to long-term steps (regional passive replicas + cross-region token mirrors). For now, keep updates here. :thumbsup:
